Common Questions

Frequently Asked

Lagos orders typically arrive within 1–2 business days. Orders to other Nigerian states take 2–5 business days depending on location. You'll receive a tracking link via WhatsApp and email as soon as your order is dispatched.
Yes! We ship to the UK, US, Canada, and select European countries. International shipping takes 7–14 business days. Customs fees and import duties are the responsibility of the customer and vary by country.
Once your order ships, you'll get a tracking number via WhatsApp and email. You can also use the Track My Order form on this page. If you haven't received your tracking details within 24 hours of purchase, contact us directly.
We accept returns within 14 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Custom or personalised pieces are non-returnable. Contact us via WhatsApp to initiate a return and we'll guide you through the process.
Want a different colour or style? We offer free exchanges within 14 days. Simply return your item and let us know what you'd like instead. If there's a price difference, we'll sort the balance via transfer or refund.
Absolutely. All Giftij Brandy bags use full-grain or pebbled genuine leather. We list the exact leather type and origin on each product page. We never use bonded leather or PU — you're getting the real thing, every time.
Yes! Every bag arrives in our signature gold-and-black gift box, with a branded dust bag, gold authenticity card, and care guide card. It's gift-ready right out of the box.
We accept card payments (Mastercard, Visa), bank transfers, and payments via Paystack. For international orders, we also accept PayPal. All transactions are secured with SSL encryption.
Yes! We offer a layaway plan for orders above ₦100,000. Pay 50% upfront and the balance before dispatch. Contact us on WhatsApp to set this up — we'll hold your item for up to 14 days.

Keep It Beautiful

Bag Care Guide

I

Clean Gently

Use a soft, damp cloth for surface dirt. Never use harsh chemicals, alcohol wipes, or abrasive materials on the leather.

II

Condition Regularly

Apply a leather conditioner every 3–6 months to keep the leather supple and prevent cracking. A little goes a long way.

III

Store Properly

Always store in the dust bag provided, stuffed lightly to maintain shape. Keep away from direct sunlight and humidity.

IV

Protect From Rain

Use a leather protector spray before exposure to wet conditions. If caught in rain, blot dry with a soft cloth — never rub.
